topics.description: The user's main concern or reason for starting the conversation.
topics.completion_rule: Understand the primary situation or concern in the user's own words.
transition_hints: Explore how this situation has affected the user.
Understand what changed.

topics.description: Persistent sadness, emotional low mood, emptiness or hopelessness.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing emotional state.
transition_hints: Mood often affects daily life.
Mood changes may influence motivation.

topics.description: Loss of motivation or enjoyment in previously enjoyable activities.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about enjoyment or motivation.
transition_hints: Changes in motivation often affect routines.

topics.description: Changes in sleep quality, duration or routine.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about sleep.
transition_hints: Sleep often affects daytime functioning.

topics.description: Fatigue, exhaustion or lack of energy.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing energy.
transition_hints: Energy changes often affect productivity.

topics.description: Changes in eating habits or appetite.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing appetite.
transition_hints: Appetite changes sometimes accompany stress.

topics.description: Difficulty focusing, remembering or making decisions.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing concentration.
transition_hints: Concentration often affects work or studies.

topics.description: Feelings of guilt, failure, worthlessness or self-blame.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about self-worth.
user_examples: Everyone would be better without me.
transition_hints: Self-perception can influence emotional wellbeing.

topics.description: Changes in normal daily activities and functioning.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about daily routine.
transition_hints: Daily routines often reflect overall wellbeing.

topics.description: Feeling nervous, anxious, tense, or on edge.
topics.completion_rule: Need at least one meaningful statement describing nervousness or anxiety.
user_examples: I've been feeling anxious all the time.
I feel nervous for no reason.
transition_hints: Feeling anxious often goes along with persistent worrying.
Some people notice physical tension when they feel anxious.

topics.description: Frequent worrying or overthinking about different situations.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing excessive worry.
transition_hints: Persistent worrying sometimes affects sleep.
It can also become difficult to concentrate.

topics.description: Difficulty stopping or controlling worrying thoughts.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing inability to control worry.
user_examples: Once I start thinking I can't stop.
transition_hints: Difficulty controlling worries often affects relaxation.

topics.description: Difficulty relaxing or feeling calm.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about relaxation.
user_examples: Even during weekends I stay tense.
transition_hints: Difficulty relaxing can influence sleep quality.

topics.description: Feeling restless or unable to stay still.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing restlessness.
transition_hints: Restlessness sometimes appears together with anxiety.

topics.description: Getting frustrated, annoyed, or angry more easily than usual.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing irritability.
transition_hints: Irritability can affect interactions with other people.

topics.description: Persistent fear that something bad may happen.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing persistent fear.
user_examples: I'm scared something bad will happen.
transition_hints: Fear often leads to persistent worrying.

topics.description: Events or situations that are contributing to the user's distress.
topics.completion_rule: Need at least one meaningful stressor identified.
transition_hints: Understanding the source of stress often helps explain other experiences.

topics.description: Important changes or significant events affecting the user's life.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about a major recent life event.
transition_hints: Major life events often influence emotional wellbeing.

topics.description: Experiences related to work, education, productivity, responsibilities, or performance.
topics.completion_rule: Need at least one meaningful statement describing work or academic experiences.
user_examples: I can't focus on my studies.
transition_hints: Work and studies often affect daily routines.
Pressure from responsibilities can influence wellbeing.

topics.description: Interactions and experiences with family, friends, partners, or other important people.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about relationships.
user_examples: I've been arguing with my family.
transition_hints: Relationships can influence emotional wellbeing.
Support from others often becomes important.

topics.description: People or resources the user relies on during difficult times.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about available support.
user_examples: I talk to my best friend.
transition_hints: Support systems often influence how people manage difficult situations.

topics.description: Ways the user responds to or manages difficult experiences.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing coping methods.
user_examples: I don't really know how to cope.
transition_hints: Understanding coping helps explain how the user responds to challenges.

topics.description: Physical health experiences that may influence mental wellbeing.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about physical health if relevant.
transition_hints: Physical health sometimes affects emotional wellbeing.

topics.description: Use of alcohol, tobacco, or other substances if the user naturally mentions them.
topics.completion_rule: Only explore if naturally introduced by the user.
transition_hints: Sometimes people mention using substances while dealing with stress.

topics.description: Thoughts about the future, hopes, plans, or expectations.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement about future outlook if naturally discussed.
user_examples: I don't know what comes next.
transition_hints: Looking ahead sometimes helps understand how the user sees their situation.

topics.description: Noticeable slowing down or increased restlessness in movement or speech.
topics.completion_rule: Need one meaningful statement describing slowing down or unusual restlessness.
transition_hints: Changes in movement sometimes accompany changes in energy.

topics.description: Thoughts about death, self-harm, suicide, or feeling that life is not worth living.
topics.completion_rule: Require direct evidence from the user's own words. Never infer.
user_examples: Sometimes I wish I wasn't here.
transition_hints: Always prioritize immediate safety over further exploration.
